messages:
cust_jones: Hey team — after the pinned upgrade last night our embeddings suddenly shrank. Previously vectors were 1536, now responses show 1024. Request id r-abc123. Repro steps below.

alex_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request (model param + headers) and a sample response?

cust_jones: Here — curl below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ***"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-all-pinned","input":"test"}'
```
Response snippet:
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[...],"index":0}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1}}
# len(embedding)=1024
```

marta_engineer: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: the pinned model was swapped to a quantized variant during the rollout. That quantized artifact was built with the wrong output_dim mapping (1024) — models.yaml still listed 1536. Looking into rollout logs.

ben_infra: I see a deploy event 3267894400 where canary promoted rwd-embed-all-pinned -> rwd-embed-all-q4. There was an autoscaling fallback to a cheaper variant when capacity dipped. Logs show fallback_policy: variant_substitute.

alex_support: Can you confirm if traffic hit the fallback variant or if pinned config was overwritten? Customer says pinned — pinned should prevent substitutions.

marta_engineer: Pinned config was partially applied; a bug in the resolver allowed fallback when instance_type constraint failed. Repro steps to reproduce locally:
```
# reproduce
export RW_API=...
python reproduce_embed.py --model rwd-embed-all-pinned --input-file sample.txt --threads 12
# observe embedding lengths
```

marta_engineer: Short-term mitigation: set model param to rwd-embed-all-1536 or use the model alias rwd-embed-all-stable (non-quantized) — OR we can force a redeploy to restore proper artifact.

cust_jones: Can you restore my pinned model to pre-upgrade variant? We rely on 1536 dims and index breaks.

ben_infra: Starting rollback for customer pinned variant. ETA ~18m. I'll confirm once rollover done.

deploy_bot: rollback job started: job_id j-987654, target: rwd-embed-all-pinned -> artifact v2026.03.15-1536

alex_support: I'll keep monitoring; once rollback completes we'll run test vector and re-index. Sorry for disruption :(

cust_jones: Thanks. Also a note — our indexing pipeline fails with an assertion error, I can share logs if needed.

marta_engineer: Please share the indexer's error trace. We should add an extra safety check to reject mismatched dims before returning result to API.

cust_jones: Pasting index error:
```
AssertionError: expected vec_size 1536 got 1024 at embeddings.py:87
```

ben_infra: rollback done. Confirming new artifact.

marta_engineer: ran integration test — now embedding len=1536 for pinned. We'll open a postmortem and add a config validation to the resolver.

alex_support: Closing loop with customer once they confirm indexing ok.

cust_jones: Verified — indexing resumed successfully. Thanks all :tada:
